title: South Carolina Senate Runoff Kicks Off With Chick-fil-A and Trump Calls
summary: Darline Graham and Ralph Norman emerged from a special election sprint on Tuesday to succeed Lindsey Graham. She will sell her closeness to President Trump. He will tout his conservatism.
